steps.en: The owner states the vehicle is leased to the hirer
steps.id: Owner menyatakan kendaraan disewa oleh hirer

steps.en: Rental start and end date and time fields appear
steps.id: Kolom tanggal dan jam mulai serta akhir sewa muncul

steps.en: All four rental period fields must be filled in
steps.id: Keempat kolom periode sewa wajib diisi

steps.en: The rental period is checked against the offence dates of the selected notices
steps.id: Periode sewa dicek terhadap tanggal offence notice yang dipilih

steps.en: The system checks again and the rental period is saved
steps.id: Sistem mengecek ulang dan periode sewa disimpan
